headline: Surabaldiyeva: Residents of undelivered houses cannot be transferred to commercial tariffs
summary: Residents of apartment buildings not yet commissioned should not pay utility bills at commercial tariffs, an official said, according to 24.kg. The question was raised by the official.
why: Utility tariff rules affect household costs and the revenue of municipal service providers in the housing sector.
original_headline: Сурабалдиева: Жильцов несданных домов нельзя переводить на коммерческие тарифы
